external_entities.name: pet owner
external_entities.description: A pet owner who books appointments and reads their pets' records in the owner app, and gets invoices by email.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Pet owners book appointments and read their pets' records in the owner app.

external_entities.name: clinic staff
external_entities.description: A vet, nurse or receptionist who uses the clinic desktop app on the clinic network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Vets, nurses and receptionists use the clinic desktop app on the clinic network, and it calls the same clinic API.

external_entities.name: partner lab
external_entities.description: The partner lab that sends test results over the internet.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The partner lab sends test results over the internet to the lab results importer.

processes.name: clinic API
processes.description: The API that the owner app and the clinic desktop app call. It checks that a pet belongs to the signed-in owner's account, and keeps owners, pets, appointments and medical notes in the records database.
processes.source_excerpt: The owner app calls the clinic API, which is on the internet.
processes.notes: Stated in the source: "When an owner opens a record, the clinic API checks that the pet belongs to that owner's account." and "Every staff account can do everything in the clinic API, including deleting medical notes: we never set up roles, because each clinic has only a few staff."

processes.name: lab results importer
processes.description: Receives test results from the partner lab over the internet and writes each one into the pet's record in the records database.
processes.source_excerpt: The importer writes each result into the pet's record in the records database.
processes.notes: Stated in the source: "It does not check which clinic the result is for, or whether the lab may send results for that pet: it writes every result it receives."

processes.name: billing service
processes.description: Reads appointments from the records database and sends invoices to owners by email.
processes.source_excerpt: The billing service reads appointments from the records database and sends invoices to owners by email.
processes.notes: A hedge in the source: "Priya thinks the billing service checks each request against the caller's role, but nobody has confirmed it."

data_stores.description: Holds owners, pets, appointments, medical notes and lab results.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The clinic API keeps owners, pets, appointments and medical notes in the records database.
